review_scope: local-only survival/observability and migration continuation panel

checks.question: Are token clusters independent observations?
checks.evidence: One row/unit per mint; repeated event rows are not counted as independent assets, but calendar-day dependence remains.

checks.question: Were cluster definitions outcome-tuned?
checks.evidence: Fixed first-10m trade-count bins; no return or mark outcome was used.

checks.question: Are sparse activity and provider missingness separated?
checks.evidence: NO_FUTURE_TRADE and TOKEN_INACTIVE are retained; PROVIDER_EVENT_GAP and TRUE_UNKNOWN remain valid states and are zero only in this restored sample.

checks.question: Could collection boundary create false Runner failures?
checks.evidence: All 30 Day-2 migrants are right-censored at 24h/48h/72h; zeros are not interpreted as outcomes.

checks.question: Was Day-1 compact Dune silently pooled with Day-2 events?
checks.evidence: Day-1 is a separate descriptive block because point-in-time event features are unavailable.

checks.question: Does the panel establish predictive edge?
checks.evidence: One event-level day, no model fit, no return comparison, no temporal holdout.

checks.question: Does migration activity equal an executable exit or Runner success?
checks.evidence: Continuation is activity-only; quoted marks, liquidity, slippage, and PumpSwap venue continuity are not inferred.

checks.question: Can 24h/48h/72h activity be compared across days?
checks.evidence: Day-2 is right-censored and Day-1 is a targeted PumpSwap sample with different provider/venue semantics.

checks.question: Were external resources or permissions used?
checks.evidence: No provider calls, purchases, credentials, wallets, alerts, scanner changes, or execution actions.

adversarial_failure_modes: A high first-10m cluster may proxy for survivorship/visibility rather than predictive quality.
The recovered sample may not represent all launches or all migrations.
Event timestamps and collection boundary can hide late continuation.
Migration-before-horizon is a lifecycle label and may overlap with venue transition; it is not a return outcome.
Zero PROVIDER_EVENT_GAP in one restored day cannot validate provider completeness globally.
required_before_modeling: Frozen point-in-time feature and mark contracts
All-migrant or clearly weighted migration denominator
decision: BLOCKED BY OUTCOME COVERAGE; retain panel as descriptive evidence and acquire one additional predeclared event-level day only after fresh resource preflight
